title: RiskEvidenceBundle
description: Aggregated detector evidence. Aggregation preserves everything: individual findings are never dropped, unknown never becomes low, disagreement becomes 'conflicting' with all sides visible. Consumes detector-output.v1 (pinned scam-guard contract, ../imports/scam-guard/).

overall_level.description: aggregate: max severity of confident findings; 'unknown' when no detector produced confident evidence; 'conflicting' when confident detectors disagree materially

overall_rationale.description: human-readable explanation composed only from findings below — no unexplained verdicts

findings.description: verbatim normalized detector outputs (detector-output.v1 instances); empty array is legal and MUST yield overall_level=unknown

conflicts.description: explicit pairs of materially disagreeing findings, both visible

detectors_unavailable.description: detectors that were configured but did not answer — visible absence, not silent absence

detector_contract_version.description: version of the pinned scam-guard detector contract
